# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser game called **Moonlit Money Tycoon**. It is a cozy satirical anime lo-fi neon city micro-tycoon for one-thumb mobile play. The player taps an isometric 4x4 city grid to build neon money kiosks, hire sleepy main-character workers, wait for a short idle shift timer, collect dream coin payouts, and reset spent pods to run the loop again. Keep the original mechanics exact: $600 start, $300 build cost, $150 payout, 5-second timer, three tools, invalid-action feedback, no hard fail/win. Visually use fairycore sparkles, kidcore rounded UI, pixel-art HUD counters, neon skyline, moon, drifting clouds, glowing coin particles, and meme copy such as “fr fr” and “main character energy.” Use browser-native HTML/CSS/Canvas, catalog-approved fonts/audio/GIFs, and a mobile-safe HUD with tappable controls.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile-first isometric micro-tycoon / idle income loop.
- objective: Spend starting money to build rooms, activate them with a worker/guest action, wait for a timer, collect payout, then clean/reset so the room can earn again.
- input model: One-thumb tap/click on canvas grid tiles plus three HUD tool buttons; UI buttons use native click/tap and canvas prevents default only for playfield input.
- core loop: Start -> initialize 4x4 grid -> select Build/Reception/Maid tool -> tap tile -> state machine moves empty_lot -> room_empty -> room_occupied -> room_ready -> room_dirty -> room_empty while money decreases/increases.
- fail/friction state: Invalid actions show floating text and error feedback; insufficient funds blocks building; there is no hard fail or win state.

## Protected mechanics
- 4x4 isometric grid coordinate conversion, camera centering, tile tap targeting, and one-tap interactions.
- Economy values: start $600, build cost $300, payout $150, stay/shift timer 5 seconds.
- State transitions: empty lot can be built; empty built room can be activated; occupied room matures on timer; ready room can always be collected; dirty room must be reset/cleaned before reuse.
- Score semantics: money decreases on build and increases only when collecting a ready tile.
- Mobile input semantics: HUD controls remain tap buttons; canvas interactions remain pointerdown tile taps.

## Remixed target
Moonlit Money Tycoon reframes the same loop as a satirical cozy anime lo-fi neon city money stacker. Empty lots are glowing kiosk pads, built rooms are neon money pods, check-in becomes hiring a sleepy main-character shift, ready payout becomes dream coins, and cleaning becomes a bubble reset. The rebuilt surface keeps the mechanics intact while replacing hotel identity with fairycore/pixel/kidcore city visuals, readable one-thumb HUD, meme copy, catalog-backed neon/cozy audio, and animated procedural skyline ownership.
